# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 10 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_010_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 10

**10:1** A council of the priests was convened. They said: "Let us weave a veil for the temple of the Lord." The high priest said: "Call for me the undefiled virgins from the tribe of David." The servants went out and searched and found seven virgins. Then the priest remembered the child Mary — she was of the tribe of David and had remained undefiled before God. The servants went and brought her as well.

**10:2** They were brought into the temple of the Lord, and the priest said: "Cast lots among you to determine who shall weave which portion: the gold, the white, the linen, the silk, the hyacinth-blue, the scarlet, and the true purple."

**10:3** The true purple and the scarlet fell to Mary by lot, and she took them and went to her house. At that time Zechariah became unable to speak, and Samuel took his place until Zechariah regained his voice. And Mary took the scarlet thread and began to spin.
